dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Good morning, Amir. Please sit down. I'm Asel Nurmagambetova, Head of the Student Internship Programme.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Good morning, Ms Nurmagambetova. Thank you for the opportunity to interview today.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Tell me a little about yourself and why you're applying for this internship.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I'm a second-year Computer Science student at WKU. I've been working on personal coding projects since I was fifteen, and I've been preparing for this internship for three months. I'm applying because I want real experience before I graduate.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Have you had any work experience before?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Not formally. But I've been building a student timetable app for WKU in my spare time. It's not finished, but it's working, and about thirty students have been using it for the past two months.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: That's impressive. What have you been learning most recently?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I've been studying machine learning for the past six weeks. I've been watching online courses and practising with real datasets.

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I've been told I sometimes focus too deeply on one problem and miss the bigger picture. I've been working on this by setting time limits on tasks and checking in with colleagues more regularly.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Good self-awareness. Why should we choose you over other candidates?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Because I've already been doing this work. I haven't been waiting for someone to give me experience — I've been creating it myself.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Where do you see yourself in five years?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: I've been thinking about this a lot. Ideally, I'd like to be working as a machine learning engineer on problems that have real social impact — perhaps in education or healthcare.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: Thank you, Amir. Do you have any questions for us?

dialogue.speaker: Amir
dialogue.text: Yes — how long have the current interns been working on the main project? I'd love to understand the level of contribution expected.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer
dialogue.text: The current team has been working together for about eight weeks. We'll be in touch within three days. Thank you for coming in.
